# ProvinceSelector

Figma: [08j. ProvinceSelector](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-962) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

Lets an investor pick their preferred geographic region(s) for investment - a label + a wrap of selectable region chips. Single-select (one region) or Multi-select (several). Composed from the RegionChip atom. RTL primary, LTR mirrored.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/province-selector/reference.png`

### ProvinceSelector

Titled group of wrapping RegionChips for the investor's preferred Saudi region (Western, Eastern, Northern, Southern, Central); single select by default.

Level: organism · Contains: RegionChip

Use when:
- Goal setup or preferences: which region to invest in
- Selection=Multi when several regions apply

Don't use when:
- Beyond about 8 options use Select
- For static labels use Tag

Accessibility: Single = radiogroup, Multi = toggle buttons; label the group.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | `selection` | variant | Single, Multi | Single |

### RegionChip

44 px selectable chip; Selected is brand-filled with inverse text, Default is outlined.

Level: atom · Part of: ProvinceSelector

Use when:
- Options in ProvinceSelector
- Any short single or multi choice-chip pattern (up to about 8 options)

Don't use when:
- For non-interactive labels use Tag
- For list selection use SelectRow

Accessibility: Expose checked/pressed state, not only colour.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

ProvinceSelector captures a preference - which Saudi region the investor wants deals from. It is a titled group of selectable chips, single-select by default (one region active).

The chip is its own atom (RegionChip), not the Tag badge - Tag is a non-interactive label with no selected/outlined state, whereas RegionChip is a 44px, r8, selectable control matching the legacy “Select input”.

### Anatomy

A label (with optional info tooltip) over a wrapping row of RegionChips. One chip is selected (brand-filled); the rest are default (outlined).

### Parts

- Label - the question (“Geographic investment location”), with an optional info icon.
- RegionChip - one selectable region; Selected = bg/brand/primary + white, Default = outlined.
- Wrap - chips flow across rows (WRAP), gap 5.

### States - RegionChip

The chip has two states:

- Selected - the chosen region: bg/brand/primary fill, text/inverse label.
- Default - available but unselected: transparent fill, border/default outline, text/default label.

### Selection - single & multi

Single is the default - a radiogroup where exactly one region is active. Multi turns the chips into toggles so an investor can pick several regions.

Single - one region

Multi - several regions

- Single (default) - radiogroup semantics; selecting a region deselects the previous.
- Multi - checkbox/toggle semantics; each chip independently on/off, several can be active.
- Same RegionChip atom for both - only the group behaviour and count of selected chips differ.

### Direction - LTR and RTL

RTL (Arabic) is primary; LTR mirrors it. Label aligns to the reading-start side and the chips wrap from there.

RTL - العربية

LTR - English

### Code examples

```typescript
<ProvinceSelector
  dir="rtl"
  label="موقع الاستثمار الجغرافي"
  value="western"
  options={["western","eastern","northern","southern","central"]}
  onChange={setRegion}
/>
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Default to single-select - one region is a clear, decisive preference.

Do

Switch to Multi only when several regions genuinely apply, and keep the option set short.

Don’t

Don’t cram a long list (all cities) into chips - beyond ~8 options a Select dropdown is far more usable.

Don’t

Don’t use Tag for selection - it’s a static badge with no selected/toggle state. Use RegionChip.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Tip:** RegionChip is a new atom because Tag is a badge (no selected/outlined state, wrong size). Reuse RegionChip for any single/multi choice-chip pattern.

> **Info:** Single-select by default (radiogroup); a Multi variant is a straightforward extension (toggle chips).

> **Warning:** Arabic labels here render in Tajawal - the DS standard IBM Plex Sans Arabic won’t load in this plugin env. Re-font to it before publishing.
